sloka: पताकिन्यस्तु ता नाव: स्वयं दाशैरधिष्ठिता: ।वहन्त्यो जनमारूढं तदा सम्पेतुराशुगा: ।। २.८९.१५ ।।
transliteration: patākinyastu tā nāva: svayaṁ dāśairadhiṣṭhitā: ।vahantyo janamārūḍhaṁ tadā sampeturāśugā: ।। 2.89.15 ।।

translations.english: The clamour of the people setting fire to the temporary shelters in that camp, descending down the river and transporting the supplies into the boats reached the heaven.
